title: HikariCP Connection Pool Exhaustion on Checkout Service
description: Production checkout API latency spiked to 14,000ms. HikariPool-1 throws ConnectionTimeout: Connection is not available, request timed out after 30005ms (active=50, idle=0, waiting=124). Postgres max_connections limit not breached, but pool size is clamped at 50.
reference_root_cause: Unbounded read transactions in checkout reconciliation batch worker holding pool connections open without releasing them, starving customer checkout threads.
reference_solution: 1. Set hikari.leak-detection-threshold=2000ms. 2. Isolate batch reconciliation to dedicated read-only pool. 3. Increase max-pool-size to 100 with connection-timeout=5000ms.

title: Postgres connection dropouts during midnight invoice reconciliation
description: Nightly billing job hangs with 'FATAL: sorry, too many clients already' and Hikari reports connection unavailable after 30s timeout. Threads waiting exceeds 80.
reference_root_cause: Batch reconciliation worker holding connections across multi-statement transaction loop without connection pooling ceiling.
reference_solution: 1. Separate batch worker onto dedicated secondary connection pool. 2. Enable connection leak detection at 2000ms. 3. Bound pool size.

title: Stripe 504 Gateway Timeout on Capture API
description: Payment authorization succeeds but capture endpoint fails intermittently with 504 Gateway Timeout during peak flash sale. Customer accounts charged twice when front-end retried without Idempotency-Key.
reference_root_cause: Synchronous capture call in web request handler times out after 10s default gateway timeout; lack of deterministic client-side idempotency keys triggers duplicate capture attempts on retry.
reference_solution: 1. Mandate UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key header on all Stripe capture requests. 2. Offload capture to background queue with exponential backoff (initial=1s, max=30s, max_retries=5). 3. Set gateway timeout to 25s.

title: Payment capture timeouts and double debit reports on mobile app
description: Mobile app users report seeing double debits after spinner hung for 15 seconds. Stripe API logs show HTTP 504 on POST /v1/payment_intents/capture followed by an immediate duplicate request from app.
reference_root_cause: Synchronous payment capture timeout causes client retry storm without unique idempotency key header.
reference_solution: 1. Pass persistent Idempotency-Key header per transaction UUID. 2. Move capture execution into idempotent asynchronous queue worker.

title: Public Catalog API returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests to partner integrations
description: Wholesale partners report catalog sync failed with 429 status code. Rate limit redis token bucket drained unexpectedly because cluster replica lag dropped key expiry TTLs.
reference_root_cause: Sliding window token bucket rate limiter in Redis cluster suffered from missing EXPIRE TTL on key renewal during replica failover, causing burst limit to lock indefinitely at 0 capacity.
reference_solution: 1. Use atomic Lua script for GET+INCR+EXPIRE in Redis rate limiter. 2. Implement client header retry-after with jitter. 3. Expand tier 2 partner quota from 500 req/min to 2500 req/min.

title: Partner sync job blocked by continuous 429 Too Many Requests response
description: B2B catalog ingestion agent receiving 429 errors continuously for 2 hours. Redis rate limiter bucket is stuck at zero available tokens despite partner pausing requests.
reference_root_cause: Rate limit redis keys failed to expire due to non-atomic key setting without TTL during failover.
reference_solution: 1. Apply atomic Lua script rate-limiting script with mandatory TTL. 2. Flush stuck partner rate limiter keys.

title: JWT Signature Verification Failure after Auth0 Key Rotation
description: All microservices rejecting inbound user bearer tokens with 'jwt.exceptions.InvalidSignatureError: Signature verification failed'. Happened 10 minutes after scheduled JWKS key rotation.
reference_root_cause: API gateway cached JWKS public keys in memory for 24 hours without cache invalidation on unknown 'kid' (Key ID), rejecting valid tokens signed with newly rotated private key.
reference_solution: 1. Implement cache refresh fallback in JWKS client: when token kid is not in cache, trigger immediate JWKS endpoint fetch before failing. 2. Set max cache TTL to 1 hour.

title: User login failures: Invalid token signature across frontend services
description: Users are booted to login page with 'Signature verification failed' message. Auth0 logs confirm new key ID kid=2026-q4 active, but gateway service uses old kid=2026-q3.
reference_root_cause: Gateway JWKS key cache does not refresh when encountering an unseen kid header.
reference_solution: 1. Configure JWKS fetch-on-cache-miss hook. 2. Invalidate stale in-memory key cache.

title: Cross-Origin Request Blocked (CORS) on Staging Webhooks Endpoint
description: Merchant dashboard cannot trigger test webhooks: 'Access to fetch at https://api-stg.internal.io from origin https://merchant-stg.app has been blocked by CORS policy: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is present'.
reference_root_cause: FastAPI CORSMiddleware regex pattern omitted subdomain wildcard for staging environments (*.merchant-stg.app).
reference_solution: 1. Update allow_origin_regex in CORS middleware to r'https://.*\.merchant-stg\.app'. 2. Explicitly include Access-Control-Allow-Credentials and required headers.

title: Merchant portal CORS failure when submitting test webhook dispatch
description: Preflight OPTIONS request returns 403 Forbidden with CORS origin missing on staging webhook console.
reference_root_cause: CORS origin configuration strictly lists production domains only and blocks staging subdomains.
reference_solution: 1. Add staging domain wildcard pattern to CORSMiddleware. 2. Verify OPTIONS 200 preflight status.

title: SendGrid Webhook Signature Verification Dropping Order Notifications
description: Inbound order confirmation emails dropping silently. SendGrid webhook listener logs: 'ECDSA signature verification failed for X-Twilio-Email-Event-Webhook-Signature'.
reference_root_cause: Webhook body parser in middleware consumed raw stream as parsed JSON before passing to SendGrid cryptographic signature validator, modifying newline byte representations.
reference_solution: 1. Capture raw unparsed byte buffer req.rawBody prior to JSON parsing middleware. 2. Pass raw bytes directly to EventWebhook.verifySignature().

title: Email delivery events failing signature check on ingest server
description: Customer notification status not updating. Error log shows SendGrid event signature mismatch on all inbound POST payloads.
reference_root_cause: Raw payload string was modified by JSON parsing middleware before cryptographic validation.
reference_solution: 1. Use raw request body buffer for SendGrid ECDSA verification. 2. Prevent body mutation before verification.

title: PostgreSQL Deadlock detected on inventory reservation table
description: Concurrent cart checkout threads throw 'deadlock detected: Process 4123 waits for ShareLock on transaction; Process 4124 waits for ExclusiveLock'. HTTP 500 returned to 12% of buyers.
reference_root_cause: Cart service locks multiple SKU rows in arbitrary order (SKU B then SKU A in thread 1, SKU A then SKU B in thread 2) inside concurrent transactions.
reference_solution: 1. Enforce strict alphabetical SKU ID sorting before acquiring SELECT FOR UPDATE locks. 2. Set statement_timeout = 3000ms.

title: Inventory checkout transaction deadlock under high concurrency
description: Flash sale spikes cause deadlock errors on sku_inventory row updates. Transactions roll back with Error 40P01.
reference_root_cause: Inconsistent lock acquisition ordering between concurrent reservation queries.
reference_solution: 1. Sort items by SKU ascending before executing SELECT ... FOR UPDATE. 2. Implement application retry with jitter.

title: Currency Conversion Rounding Drift on Multi-Currency Invoices
description: EUR and JPY settlements off by 1 cent/yen compared to payment provider total, causing accounting ledger reconciliation freeze.
reference_root_cause: Floating-point IEEE-754 arithmetic used instead of Decimal fixed-point integers in currency calculation module.
reference_solution: 1. Convert all monetary calculations to integer lowest denomination (cents/yen). 2. Use Decimal with ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

title: Cross-border settlement discrepancy due to float point rounding
description: Financial ledger reports mismatch of €0.01 on order payouts for European customers.
reference_root_cause: Float representations in tax and currency multiplier functions creating decimal drift.
reference_solution: 1. Adopt integer cents for all intermediate accounting steps. 2. Use Python decimal module with banker's rounding.

title: GraphQL Depth-Limit Throttling False Positives on Order History Query
description: Admin customer care portal receives HTTP 429 / QueryRejected: Query exceeds maximum allowed complexity score of 250 on nested customer orders query.
reference_root_cause: Complexity cost multiplier counted union fragment types twice on customer profile sub-fields.
reference_solution: 1. Fix GraphQL complexity calculator to deduplicate union type fields. 2. Increase authenticated admin threshold to 500.

title: Admin dashboard customer order lookup rejected by complexity limiter
description: Support reps cannot view customer profiles due to GraphQL complexity error 429.
reference_root_cause: Fragment deduplication bug in query cost scoring algorithm.
reference_solution: 1. Deduplicate type fragment scoring in GraphQL middleware. 2. Whitelist support role complexity tier.

title: OAuth2 State Parameter Mismatch during SSO Callback
description: Okta SSO users receive 'HTTP 400 invalid_grant: state parameter mismatch' after authenticating via mobile Safari.
reference_root_cause: SameSite=Lax cookie attribute dropped on cross-site redirect in Safari Intelligent Tracking Prevention (ITP).
reference_solution: 1. Set SameSite=None and Secure=True on the OAuth state cookie. 2. Use partition-aware cookie headers for embedded webviews.

title: Corporate SSO login failing on Safari due to state parameter error
description: Enterprise customers on iOS devices cannot log in via Okta. Error log notes missing state cookie in callback handler.
reference_root_cause: Safari ITP cookie suppression on cross-origin redirects without SameSite=None; Secure.
reference_solution: 1. Configure SameSite=None; Secure for OAuth session cookies. 2. Enable PKCE verification as secondary verification.

title: Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance Storm on Log Ingest Topic
description: Log collector pods crashing with 'CommitFailedException: The max.poll.interval.ms elapsed before consumer invoked poll'. Triggers cascading rebalance storm.
reference_root_cause: Heavy batch parsing inside consumer loop exceeded max.poll.interval.ms (30000ms), causing Kafka broker to consider consumer dead and trigger rebalance.
reference_solution: 1. Increase max.poll.interval.ms to 300000ms (5 min). 2. Decrease max.poll.records from 500 to 100. 3. Offload document parsing to worker thread pool.

title: Event stream consumer disconnects and infinite rebalance cycle
description: Analytics worker nodes dropping from consumer group continuously, lagging behind topic offsets by 4 million records.
reference_root_cause: Processing time for large JSON payloads exceeding Kafka heartbeat poll interval.
reference_solution: 1. Reduce max.poll.records to 100. 2. Set max.poll.interval.ms to 300s. 3. Decouple record polling from heavy CPU processing.

title: Cloudflare Cache Purge API 400 Bad Request on Wildcard URL
description: Content publishing service fails with 'Cloudflare API error 1012: purge_everything or url prefixes required'. CDN continues serving stale article content.
reference_root_cause: Cloudflare purge API v4 changed wildcard syntax from 'https://example.com/posts/*' to require 'prefixes' array payload rather than 'files' parameter.
reference_solution: 1. Use {'prefixes': ['posts/']} payload for enterprise zone purge instead of wildcard asterisks. 2. Verify API token contains Zone.Cache Purge permission.

title: Stale CDN content after editorial publish: Cloudflare purge rejection
description: Writers updating homepages do not see updates reflected on edge caches. Purge endpoint returns HTTP 400.
reference_root_cause: Improper payload structure passed to Cloudflare Cache Purge API endpoint.
reference_solution: 1. Switch purge payload to 'prefixes' schema. 2. Add automated cache header verification.

title: Redis OOM Command Not Allowed when used_memory > maxmemory
description: Session store service returns 'OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory'. All user session writes failing with HTTP 500.
reference_root_cause: Redis maxmemory-policy was left at default 'noeviction' instead of 'volatile-lru' or 'allkeys-lru', preventing expired session cleanup under memory pressure.
reference_solution: 1. Set redis maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru. 2. Run CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru immediately. 3. Audit keys for explicit TTLs.

title: Session management crash due to Redis out of memory error
description: Users cannot stay logged in. Redis logs reveal memory full and writes blocked under noeviction rule.
reference_root_cause: Redis eviction policy set to noeviction under high key volume.
reference_solution: 1. Configure maxmemory-policy to allkeys-lru. 2. Enforce 7-day TTL on session tokens.

title: 3D Secure 2.0 Webhook Friction Failure on Adyen Integration
description: European credit card payments hanging on CHALLENGE_SHOPPER status without resolving to AUTHORISED. Conversion dropped 35%.
reference_root_cause: Frontend checkout component dropped the threeDSMethodData hidden iframe required for frictionless risk assessment, forcing full manual challenge on every card.
reference_solution: 1. Embed Adyen 3DS2 device fingerprinting iframe during card entry. 2. Handle challengeResult notification in returnUrl.

title: Excessive 3DS verification challenges causing checkout abandonment
description: Customers reporting repetitive SMS security codes on small purchases. Payment gateway logs frictionless flow disabled.
reference_root_cause: Missing device fingerprint payload in initial authorization request.
reference_solution: 1. Reinstate device fingerprint collection script on checkout page. 2. Pass shopper fingerprint string to gateway.

title: AWS SES Email Sending Rate Exceeded 454 Throttling Failure
description: Password reset emails delayed by up to 45 minutes. SES SMTP logs: '454 Throttling failure: Maximum sending rate exceeded'.
reference_root_cause: Transactional email sender fired unbuffered asynchronous tasks exceeding account limit of 50 emails/second during newsletter blast.
reference_solution: 1. Separate marketing and transactional email traffic into dedicated configuration sets. 2. Implement SQS queue with rate-limited consumer at 40 msg/sec.

title: Password reset queue backlogged due to email provider rate limit
description: Users complain verification emails taking an hour to arrive. SES logs show 454 Throttling errors.
reference_root_cause: Unthrottled parallel email dispatch exceeding provider burst limits.
reference_solution: 1. Route transactional emails via isolated high-priority rate-limited queue. 2. Request SES quota increase.

title: Kubernetes Ingress TLS Certificate Expired on Internal Microservice
description: Payment worker unable to contact inventory service: 'x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid'. cert-manager failed to renew Let's Encrypt certificate.
reference_root_cause: Cert-manager ClusterIssuer ACME HTTP01 challenge failed because ingress routing rule intercepted .well-known/acme-challenge requests.
reference_solution: 1. Whitelist /.well-known/acme-challenge/* path in root ingress controller. 2. Trigger cert-manager certificate renew manually. 3. Add alerting at 14 days before expiry.

title: SSL handshake failure between internal services after certificate expiry
description: Internal REST calls fail with TLS error x509 expired certificate. Cluster cert-manager not updating pods.
reference_root_cause: ACME HTTP01 challenge blocked by API gateway path routing.
reference_solution: 1. Ensure ACME challenge route bypasses application auth middleware. 2. Force cert-manager renewal.
